# Getting Support

Need help with KrisuAI Pinaka? Here's how to get assistance:

## Documentation

Start with our comprehensive documentation:
- **[README](../README.md)** - Overview and quick start
- **[User Guide](../VS-code-ext/USER_GUIDE.md)** - Complete manual
- **[FAQ](../VS-code-ext/FAQ.md)** - Frequently asked questions
- **[Troubleshooting](../VS-code-ext/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)** - Common issues

## Community Support

### GitHub Discussions (Recommended)
- **[Q&A](https://github.com/KrisuAI/Pinaka/discussions/categories/q-a)** - Ask questions
- **[Ideas](https://github.com/KrisuAI/Pinaka/discussions/categories/ideas)** - Suggest features
- **[Show and Tell](https://github.com/KrisuAI/Pinaka/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)** - Share success stories

### Report Issues
- **[Bug Reports](https://github.com/KrisuAI/Pinaka/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)** - Report bugs
- **[Feature Requests](https://github.com/KrisuAI/Pinaka/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)** - Request features

## Response Times

- **Community Questions:** Usually within 24-48 hours
- **Bug Reports:** Triaged within 2-3 business days
- **Feature Requests:** Reviewed in monthly planning

## Email Support

For private inquiries:
- **General:** support@krisuai.com
- **Security:** security@krisuai.com
- **Business:** business@krisuai.com

## Before Asking for Help

Please:
1. Search existing discussions and issues
2. Check the documentation
3. Include version information and error logs
4. Describe steps to reproduce the issue

Thank you for being part of the KrisuAI Pinaka community!
